name: New Year Countdown Clock
summary: A year-independent near-midnight clock with festive star decorations.
description: Original stylized 11:55 clock display with gold bezel, separate hands, markers and stars.
author: Blender 3D Gallery / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original procedural Blender Python geometry and materials; numerals use Blender's bundled Bfont converted to editable meshes. No external models or imagery.
rights: Original asset; public redistribution terms have not been specified.

attribution.credit: Original geometry and materials created for Blender 3D Gallery; numerals use Blender bundled Bfont converted to mesh.

accuracy_notes: Stylized static clock face set to 11:55. It is not a live countdown, timepiece or animated clock.
material_notes: Clock face, hands, numerals, markers and stars remain separate in the Blender source; the GLB batches meshes by material.
